messages:
Sam - Finance: Heads up: customer FlowMetrics got billed 12.1M tokens on 2026-03-14 invoice but their dashboard shows ~6.2M. Can we triage?
Nina - Billing: Invoice FM-2026-03-14? Org id? I'll pull invoice lines.
Sam - Finance: FM-2026-03-14, org flowmetrics-prod (org_1122). Metering-bot flagged a replay/rate pattern earlier.
metering-bot: Notice 1026-03-141 unusual retry flood for org_1122 between 16:10-16:40 UTC. provisional_rows=5,920, duplicates_detected=4,980.
Omar - Eng Infra: Quick summary: ingress writes provisional ledger rows immediately, then finalization updates or cancels. Invoice job accidentally included provisional rows from a snapshot job ran during finalization window.
Nina - Billing: If invoicing snapshot included provisional rows we may have double-counted. Can you confirm how many provisional rows were included?
Omar - Eng Infra: Running a query now. Results: of the 12,102,334 tokens billed, 5,911,800 tokens came from provisional rows that never finalized. Another 4,982,400 tokens belonged to duplicate provisional entries that were later deduped but included in the snapshot.
Sam - Finance: So corrected tokens should be ~1.2M? That seems low. Please provide final tally for finalized rows only.
Omar - Eng Infra: Finalized (consumed/finalized) tokens in that window = 6,204,134. The invoicing snapshot used interim_cache_v2 which did not filter provisional=false.
Zoe - Revenue Ops: Recommend issuing provisional credit and notifying customer with a short note and apology. Also propose a small goodwill credit for the inconvenience.
Nina - Billing: I'll compute credit amount once Omar shares token delta and unit price. Also need list of ledger_row_ids to reverse in accounting system.
Omar - Eng Infra: Export attached to internal ticket (csv). Delta = 5,898,200 tokens.
Sam - Finance: At our published rate tier that's about $0.00055/token => estimated credit $3,244.01. Nina, can you prepare a draft credit memo and flag if it triggers legal review?
Nina - Billing: Will do. If credit > $5k we escalate. This is under threshold. Drafting memo now.
Omar - Eng Infra: Patch plan: 1) Update invoicing snapshot job to exclude provisional rows and to re-run only affected invoices; 2) add a guard that the job checks finalized=true or final_update_ts older than 2m; 3) backfill dedupe for provisional rows older than 24h. I'll open a PR.
Sam - Finance: Good. Do we know root cause of replay flood? Could be SDK retries or client misconfiguration.
Omar - Eng Infra: Early signals show client SDK BrightFlow/0.9.5 sending retries without idempotency keys. Also a misconfigured proxy at customer side caused rapid reconnects. We'll include SDK guidance in customer note.
Zoe - Revenue Ops: I'll draft a short customer-facing message: explain error, confirm corrected invoice + credit, offer help with SDK upgrade. Keep tone concise.
Nina - Billing: Credit memo ready and applied to account; emailed flowmetrics billing contact with explanation and attached corrected invoice.
Omar - Eng Infra: Patch merged and deployed. Invoicing job re-run for 3 affected invoices.
Sam - Finance: Closing — thanks all. Nina please add thread to monthly billing incidents log.
Nina - Billing: Added. :white_check_mark:
